Nevertheless strict factual preservation is not established: a001 distributions.0.description says insects counted per inspected tree (count; e.g. 14) and treatment application volume (litres/hectare; e.g. 3.28), versus count 10/rate 10.03 in 39032 and count 26/rate 6.48 in 39033.
